risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and well quantified, with segment results, margins, cash-related metrics, and year-over-year drivers provided. Risk tone is cautiously positive because profitability and EBITDA improved materially, but low net income, goodwill impairments, restructuring items, cost pass-through effects, and dependence on temporary customer restocking indicate continuing earnings risk.
